reason: Independent Go 1.26.6 plain/woven tests show that eager header rebuilding loses caller-visible map and value-slice mutations. A directly called helper also fails, so the result does not depend on permitting http.Handler implementations to mutate requests. Defaults enable analysis with 30% sampling. The plan prescribes rebuilding but does not accept alias-breaking behavior, which violates the host-behavior rule.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/fx-sink-http-sources-F1 && env -u DD_IAST_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS GOFLAGS=-p=4 GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 DD_IAST_ENABLED=true DD_IAST_REQUEST_SAMPLING=100 timeout 720s /usr/bin/time -l go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 10m -count=1 -run '^TestHeaderDirectFunction$' -v ./reviewhttp
